description: This file defines the TranslatorInterface interface within the Goteo\\\Library\\\Translator namespace. It specifies method signatures for fetching translation-related data, indicating its role in abstracting translation operations within the application.

classes.name: TranslatorInterface
classes.description: Interface that declares methods for translation management, including retrieving translation fields, orders, specific translation entries, and CRUD operations for translation data.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Retrieve available fields for a specified zone.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieve ordering options for a specified zone.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Get a specific translation entry by zone and ID.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of translations based on filters, with pagination and count options.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Get the translation for a specific language and field, optionally respecting the original.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Get the type of the translation object.

methods.name: isOriginal
methods.description: Check if the translation is original for the given language.

methods.name: isTranslated
methods.description: Check if the translation exists for the given language.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Check if the translation is pending for the given language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a translation for the specified language.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Save translation values for a specific language.
